**UI-for-ytdlp v0.3.2** improves download reliability for large VODs (e.g. GoodGame) and keeps the download folder tidy.

#### Temporary download files
- Intermediate files (`.part`, HLS fragments) go to `{DOWNLOAD_PATH}/_UI-for-ytdlp-temp` via yt-dlp `-P temp:`
- The temp folder is removed automatically after a successful download; kept on error/cancel for `--continue`

#### ffmpeg and cancellation
- **Esc** now kills the full process tree (`taskkill /T` on Windows), including orphaned `ffmpeg.exe`
- Progress bar shows merge/ffmpeg phases (`[Merger]`, `[ffmpeg]`, `[SponsorBlock]`)

#### SponsorBlock
- `--sponsorblock-remove` applies only to **YouTube** URLs (skipped for GoodGame, VK, etc.)
